source: Generated testsrc2 + sine; preparation only, no FFmpeg runtime dependency
command: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x64:rate=6:duration=3 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=3 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -g 6 -keyint_min 6 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 2 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -shortest -movflags +faststart source.mp4
